notes: Ties 30by30 reporting directly to NRW's protected site condition assessments, so NRW monitoring capacity becomes the gate on what Wales can claim against SI1 and SI2. Pairs with the Audit Wales finding on SSSI designation capacity.
summary: The Welsh Government's 'A 30by30 framework for Wales', first published on 18 June 2025 and last updated on 7 August 2026, sits within the updated Nature Recovery Action Plan (2026). It set criteria for areas counting towards protecting 30 percent of land, freshwater and sea by 2030: Sites of Special Scientific Interest, Special Areas of Conservation and Special Protection Areas count only where evidence supports a favourable or unfavourable recovering condition assessment. Designated sites covered about 11 percent of land and about 69 percent of the inshore marine area as of 2025, and voluntary Naturfa sites are Wales' recognition of other effective area-based conservation measures.
title: Welsh Government 30by30 framework: only protected sites in favourable or recovering condition will count, with Naturfa sites as Wales' OECMs
